description: This file declares a factory function for creating instances of ISessionServerAppManager within the rialto::servermanager::common namespace. It includes necessary headers and defines the function prototype with parameters related to session server management, such as controller, observer, environment variables, session server path, startup timeout, health check interval, and socket permissions.

methods.name: createSessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Factory function to create and return a unique pointer to an ISessionServerAppManager instance, configured with provided parameters.
